title: secondary_extracted_rules
universal_lens: Causal discovery formalizes the extraction of directed acyclic graphs from observational constraints. The primitives define partial ancestral graphs (PAGs) and logical rules mapping minimal independencies to causal relations, establishing a rigorous algebraic framework for identifying structural invariants and ruling out spurious correlations.
gsi_mapping: In Galaxy Sports Intelligence, observed player metrics act as nodes in a latent causal DAG. Minimal independence tests identify unobserved confounders like fatigue or tactical adjustments, translating statistical dependencies into actionable causal edges that drive robust Bayesian hierarchical models for predictive inference.
gse_mapping: Galaxy Sports Engine utilizes these primitives to model real-time situational transitions. An uncovered potentially directed path represents a valid sequence of plays unaffected by defensive shielding, allowing the engine to compute optimal state evolutions and counter-strategies based on strict causal logic.

primitives.name: Directed Causal Relation Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: We say there is a causal relation X ⇒Y , iffthere is a directed path from X to Y in GC.
primitives.latex: X \Rightarrow Y \iff \exists \text{ directed path } X \to \dots \to Y \text{ in } G_C
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: X, Y: Dimensionless variables; G_C: Causal Directed Acyclic Graph; \Rightarrow: Causal implication operator.

primitives.name: Minimal Independence to Causality Rule
primitives.verbatim_quote: We say there is a causal relation X ⇒Y , iffthere is a directed path from X to Y in GC.
primitives.latex: X \perp\kern-10pt\not\perp Y \mid W \cup \{Z\} \vdash Z \Rightarrow (X \cup Y \cup S)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: X, Y, Z, W: Dimensionless variables; S: Selection nodes; \perp\kern-10pt\not\perp: Conditional dependence operator.
primitives.assumptions: Conditional independence statements accurately reflect the d-separation properties of the true underlying DAG.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur with exact cancellations of path coefficients (non-faithfulness) or severe measurement noise masking dependencies.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSI's detection of hidden confounders; if conditioning on a variable changes dependency, it acts as a causal pivot.
layer2.telemetry: Shift in mutual information between offensive and defensive metrics upon conditioning on environmental factors.

reasoning_traces.think:
The derivation begins by defining the Partial Ancestral Graph (PAG) as the epistemic boundary of causal knowledge obtainable from observational data. The 'uncovered potentially directed path' serves as the fundamental topological invariant, ensuring that any inferred causal chain lacks local shielding (colliders or forks) that would block information flow. By enforcing the condition that no edge has an arrowhead at the predecessor or a tail at the successor, we isolate pure causal transmission channels. This topological constraint maps directly to the algebraic rules of d-separation. When combined with the minimal independence lemma, we establish a dualism: statistical silence (independence) implies the absence of a causal path, while statistical resonance (dependence) upon conditioning reveals a causal pivot. The failure mode arises precisely when the faithfulness assumption collapses—specifically, when distinct causal pathways cancel each other out exactly, creating a false independence. In the context of sports intelligence, this means two opposing tactical pressures might perfectly balance, masking their individual causal impacts on the outcome. The primitive operators thus provide a rigorous filter, separating genuine causal leverage from spurious correlation, enabling the construction of robust, intervention-ready causal models.
